candidates.change_summary: Replace 'block.number + 1' with 'block.number' so that the settle block condition is met immediately.
Delete the require for msg.value == 1 ether, allowing free guesses.
Delete the require that the sender's block is 0, allowing overwrites of existing guesses.
Insert 'guesses[msg.sender].block = 0;' at the end, resetting block immediately and preventing settle.
Delete the require checking that block.number is greater than guesses[msg.sender].block, allowing settle to be called immediately in the same block.
Change the transfer amount from 2 ether to 1 ether.
Delete the require that guesses[msg.sender].block is nonzero, so settle can be called even without a prior lockInGuess.
Replace the blockhash lookback condition to use block.number instead of guesses[msg.sender].block.
Flip the condition to transfer only when the guess does NOT match or answer is zero.
Delete the line that resets guesses[msg.sender].block to zero after reading answer, allowing re-entry and reuse of the same block.
Change the transfer to send only 1 wei instead of 2 ether.
